title: Cowboys' Shavon Revel expects to be the best cornerback in the NFL some day

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cowboys' Shavon Revel expects to be the best cornerback in the NFL some day
sources.description: Cowboys cornerback Shavon Revel Jr. got off to a slow start as a rookie last year, missing the first 10 games because of a knee injury he had suffered in college.
